proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6333 divasa includes day and sun, dīs/dīh, and the dihāṛā series; it gives Old Marwari dhyāḍo and Gujarati dahāṛɔ. The h-bearing forms may reflect crossing with ahar and regional spread, not a regular local s-to-h change. These qualifications are retained for the day/sun responses. Exact survey form disu is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
